$note: One case per line. q = what a person types. want = the tool(s) that SHOULD surface; the case passes at K if any of them is in the top K. ok = neighbours that are defensible and are not counted as noise. kind = positive | negative | hard. A negative case wants SILENCE: any result at all is a false positive. Roughly a third of the positives are phrased in words the lexicon does NOT contain -- those are marked "lex":false and exist so this file measures the system rather than echoing config/capability-aliases.json back at it.
